name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-pre-release-forest
title: Super Mario World (Pre-release) - Forest
description:
While i was messing around with the gigaleak files, i found some tiles that were very similar to smw's forest tileset, so i added new tiles, this uses only 1 gfx slot, and uses no custom pallete.
As a bonus, the .zip file includes a sample level showing most tiles, does not include:

-luigi
-big pipes (only small pipes)
